title: Have You Ever...? Experience Questions
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! 'Have you ever...?' es una de las estructuras más útiles en el inglés corporativo para hablar de experiencias y antecedentes profesionales.

parts.visual: Usamos 'Have you ever + participio?' para preguntar sobre experiencias de vida/profesionales: Have you ever managed a team? (¿Has gestionado alguna vez un equipo?). Have you ever worked abroad? (¿Has trabajado alguna vez en el extranjero?).
parts.audio: We use Have you ever plus past participle to ask about life and professional experiences: Have you ever managed a team? Have you ever worked abroad?

parts.visual: Respuestas: Yes, I have. (Sí). No, I haven't. (No). No, I have never... (No, nunca...). Respuesta extendida: Yes, I have. I managed a team of five in my last job.
parts.audio: Answers: Yes, I have. No, I haven't. No, I have never. Extended answer: Yes, I have. I managed a team of five in my last job.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta para preguntas de experiencia.

questions.question: Have you ever ____ a presentation in English? (Given).
Have you ever ____ a new product? (Launched).
Have you ever ____ with an international client? (Worked).
Have you ever ____ from home full-time? (Worked).
Have you ever ____ a business trip? (Been on).
questions.explanation: Been on a business trip = haber estado de viaje de negocios.

questions.question: Have you ever ____ in a startup? (Worked).
Have you ever ____ a company? (Founded).
questions.explanation: Found -> Founded (regular). Nota: 'found' también es pasado de 'find'.

questions.question: Have you ever ____ to a client conference? (Been).
Yes, I have. I ____ a team in my last job. (Managed - pasado simple en respuesta).
Have you ever ____ a conflict at work? (Resolved).
Have you ever ____ a performance review? (Conducted).
Yes, I ____. I managed a team of five. (Respuesta corta).
